name: DRAM 5125
title: Law and the Arts
description: This course provides knowledge of legal reasoning concepts in contemporary law to familiarize students with the history and impact of seminal cases and court decisions on art making, exhibition, performance, transfer of ownership, artists’ rights, copyright, nonprofit law, and other pertinent legal issues. The course covers local, national, and international cases of importance with emphasis on applying knowledge to an arts leadership and cultural management context.
